title: QuantTrader: the OTM cost bar is algebraically a delta floor at 0.495 - decide the win-probability frame before any bar or k retune
description:
# The OTM cost bar is algebraically a delta floor at 0.495. Decide the win-probability frame before anyone retunes a bar or a k.

Filed by CTO from TRA-3272 item 2. The reason-split that TRA-3272 was gated on has been captured and it
falsifies the mechanism TRA-3271/TRA-3272 assumed. Full derivation, tables and live reads are on TRA-3272;
this issue carries only the open decision, which is yours.

## The finding, in one line

On the live OTM path the option take-profit/stop are pinned at `mark*1.5` / `mark*0.75`, so `rewardR` is
exactly 2.0 for every candidate, and the estimator reduces to

```
modeledGrossR = 3*|delta| - 1
```

title: TRA-3300 bricked-agent detector - roster sweep for status:error after session-limit events (CTO)
description:
PURPOSE: Detect Paperclip agents left bricked in status:error after Anthropic session-limit events (TRA-3300, board decision on TRA-3224), raise a loud wakeful escalation to a live owner, and attempt the wake-path self-heal. Measured defect: on 2026-08-11 the CEO agent sat status:error for 31+ minutes after the session window reopened at 22:00Z, with ~15 open issues behind it, until the board manually fired agent.error_cleared. The window reopening does NOT clear the state; nothing wakes an errored agent unless a new event targets it (no agent in this company has heartbeat.enabled, so the roster is purely event-driven).

VERIFIED PLATFORM FACTS (live-probed 2026-08-12 on server v2026.722.0; re-verify if serverVersion changes):
- POST /api/agents/{id}/clear-error is board-only (assertBoard): 403 "Board access required" for EVERY agent token, including a manager acting on a direct report.
- PATCH /api/agents/{id} {"status":...} cross-agent: 403 deny_no_grant (agents:configure). Self-PATCH works but a bricked agent cannot execute anything, so it is useless for unbricking.
- POST /api/agents/{id}/wakeup cross-agent: 403 "Agent can only invoke itself".
- BUT status "error" IS in INVOKAB

title: TRA-2937 ADOPT is not durable: journalIdByPosition is never snapshotted, so a rebind dies at the next restart
description:
Found by QA during the TRA-2951 pre-open fire on 2026-08-06, reading `6eb0065` at the live build `f19fb1fa30682f99b47c83149d2fef14cec95e6d`. **This is not a grade failure of TRA-2937** — the commit does what its message says for as long as the process lives. It is a durability hole underneath it, and it is the mechanism that makes the "un-fixable cohort" permanent instead of a one-off.

## The defect

`queueJournalImportOpen` splits ADOPT / MINT / AMBIGUOUS. On **ADOPT** it does not write a journal row at all — it records the binding in memory:

```
this.journalIdByPosition.set(id, existing.id);
```

`journalIdByPosition` is a plain in-memory `Map<string, string>`. **`exportSnapshot` does not serialize it and `importSnapshot` does not restore it.** The snapshot carries `openOptions` and the binding is dropped.

## Why the next boot cannot repair it

`importSnapshot` repopulates `openOptions` from the snapshot, so at the next reconcile the contract is found as `existing` with `importedFromTradier === true`. That branch updates contracts / premium and `continue`s. `queueJournalImportOpen` is reached **only** on the `added` branch — i.e. only for a contract the local book does *not* a

title: TRA-2956 telemetry: staleWorkingExits.held is documented as a gauge but implemented as a monotonic per-tick attempt counter, and never counts budget exhaustion
description:
Found pre-open on 2026-08-06 while pre-flighting the TRA-3044 grade instrument against the running
build's source (`7a53176`) rather than against its field documentation. Read-only: no orders, no
writes, no broker calls. Filing it before the bell because TRA-3044's **criterion 3 is stated in terms
of this field**, and the field does not mean what the registration (and the code's own comments) say
it means.

`staleWorkingExits.held` is documented as a gauge and implemented as a monotonic counter of failed
attempts. It is wrong in **both** directions — it can read 0 while a position is permanently
detached, and read non-zero when nothing is detached at all.

## Direction 1 — `held == 0` does not mean nothing is detached

`listStaleWorkingExits` drops a row that has exhausted its per-row withdrawal budget with a bare
`continue`:

    // packages/server/src/options-account.ts:5157
    if ((this.staleWorkingExitClears.get(id) ?? 0) >= MAX_STALE_WORKING_EXIT_CLEARS_PER_ROW) {
      continue;

title: TRA-2945 give-back mark bound - derive from the durable tape once it reaches 5 sessions per book
description:
Read the TRA-2927/TRA-2945 option-mark tape on bqb1 and, ONCE AND ONLY ONCE it is ready, derive the give-back mark bound from it.

ONE GET, no auth needed:
  curl -s https://tradingai-bqb1.onrender.com/api/health/giveback-arm-floor
and read the `markSanity` object. Work the leaf issue TRA-2945.

== STEP 0 - IS THE BUILD EVEN CARRYING THE INSTRUMENT? ==
If `markSanity.boundReadiness` is ABSENT (undefined), the live build PREDATES commit ed07fd6 and there is nothing to grade. The route answers 200 either way, so ABSENCE OF THE FIELD is the discriminator - not the status code, and not a drift number. In that state: report "STALE BUILD - boundReadiness absent", leave TRA-2945 at its resting disposition, and STOP. Do NOT deploy from this routine.

== STEP 1 - IS THE TAPE READY? ==
Read `markSanity.durability.ephemeral` FIRST. If it is true, the tape is NOT accumulating at all - nothing is on disk and every reboot wipes it. Report that as a DEFECT on TRA-2945 (it means DATA_DIR is not the persistent mount) and stop.
Then read `markSanity.boundReadiness`. If `ready` is false this is a NO-OP fire: the tape has not yet reached 5 sessions on BOTH books (see `demoSessions` / `liveSessions`).

title: TRA-2984 (50bd900) changes resolvePendingOptionExits behaviourally: the expired continue precedes withdrawStaleWorkingExit, and it is in tonight deploy
The broker-flat sweep books phantom closes during a Tradier OUTAGE: `listOpenOptionPositions()` returns [] on a non-2xx, which the sweep reads as 'flat'
description:
## Found while building TRA-3067

TRA-3067's detector deliberately refuses to consume `listOpenOptionPositions()` because that method has **no absence state**. Tracing why turned up a live path that *does* consume it and *does* act on it.

## The mechanism (read, not measured)

1. `TradierOptionsClient.getJson` (`packages/engine/src/tradier/options-client.ts:454`) returns `null` on **any** non-2xx. It does not throw.
2. `listOpenOptionPositions()` therefore returns `parseTradierPositions(null)` = `[]` — the identical value it returns for an account that genuinely holds nothing.
3. `SignalEngine.reconcileLivePortfolio` (`packages/server/src/signal-engine.ts`) wraps the call in try/catch, so it catches a *transport throw* and skips the sweep — but a 401/403/429/500/503 is not a throw. It gets `[]` and proceeds.
4. `PaperOptionsAccount.reconcileTradierPositions` (`options-account.ts:5992`) then runs the TRA-2799 broker-flat sweep against an empty map: every eligible engine-opened live row misses, `brokerMissingSweeps` increments, and on the **second** miss `closeBrokerFlatPosition` books a local close at break-even.

`BROKER_MISSING_SWEEPS_TO_CLOSE = 2` is documented as the guard agai

# A third invisible row, found after filing: the partial-fill guard counts nowhere either

Same build (`7a53176`), same read-only source pass. When I filed this I named two cases the
telemetry cannot see. There are **three**, and the new one is the one that can actively mislead a
grade rather than merely under-report.

## Guard 1 returns without touching any counter

`withdrawStaleWorkingExit`, `signal-engine.ts:6971`:

    // Guard 1 - a partial fill is a different animal; leave it working.
    if (typeof detail.exec_quantity === 'number' && detail.exec_quantity > 0) {
      log.info('stale working exit is PARTIALLY FILLED - leaving it to resolve', {...});
      return;
    }

(budget is spent in `noteStaleWorkingExitCleared`). The row keeps its `pendingExit`, so every exit
rule on it stays detached, and it is re-selected by `listStaleWorkingExits` on the *next* tick and
every tick after — hitting the same guard each time, forever, until the order goes terminal (for a
`day` order, at the close).

TRA-2217's header now asserts the credit/width ratio *is* the short-leg delta, so "the two constraints are one constraint" and the floor is the band's lower edge. That holds only as width → 0. Exactly:

Filed by LeadDev from the TRA-2617 fix. The two-class strand detector now exists and is controlled
(34/34), but **nothing runs it on a schedule** - I grepped all 167 company routines for `check:blocked-empty` /
`check:strands` and got **zero hits**.

three shape-2 strands on 2026-07-30 because they were hand-reads, not runs of this script. A detector nobody
invokes has exactly the same output as no detector.

enumeration could not prove it saw the whole population, and must be treated louder than FINDINGS.

gets the repair value, not just the count.
